bc-msf.tuitionLabel: Carroll MSF program total — 30 credits × $2,398/credit (2026–27 AY)
bc-msf.feesNote: Graduate Student Activity Fee $73/semester × 2 (Fall+Spring, 7+ credits) + Initial BC ID Card $50 = $196. Summer term with <7 credits may add $42 activity fee (not assumed). Medical Insurance $4,723 (Fall $2,083 + Spring $2,604) separate / waivable with comparable coverage.
bc-msf.period: 2026–27 (rates typically announced in April; effective summer start of AY)
bc-msf.notes: Full-time MSF: 10 courses / 30 credits / ~12 months. Regular Finance track Fall (Aug) entry only; Quantitative Finance track is STEM-designated and offers Fall Aug 2027 and Spring Jan 2027 entry. Same published per-credit tuition applies to both tracks; merit funding page does not limit awards to STEM/Quant track. Fall 2027 students will be billed on the AY rate in force when enrolled (2027–28 rates typically announced April 2027 — not published as of asOf; 2026–27 used as current published schedule).
bc-msf.stem: Quant Finance track only (Regular track not STEM per program page)

livingCostBand.basis: Carroll Tuition & Aid 2026–27 nine-month estimates: Housing $17,204 + Food $5,973 + Transportation $1,800 + Personal $2,651 + Books and Supplies $1,300 = $28,928 (excludes medical insurance).

cgu-msf.tuitionLabel: Estimated program tuition — 32 units × $2,070/unit (2025–26 published rate; 2026–27 rate not posted as of asOf)
cgu-msf.feesNote: Student Fee $245 + Technology Fee $150 = $395/semester × 2 semesters = $790. cgu-msf.period: 2025–26 unit rate on program page (covers Summer 2025–Spring 2026). Fall 2027 intake will use later AY rates — not locked.
cgu-msf.notes: Drucker School MS in Finance; STEM; 32 units; ~1 year full-time; starts Spring, Summer, or Fall (Fall 2027 classes begin Aug 30, 2027). Same per-unit rate for CA resident / nonresident / international. Tuition figure is 32×$2,070 using 2025–26 published rate marked on program page — do not treat as locked Fall 2027 sticker.

illinois-msf.tuitionLabel: Gies MSF international tuition total — 3 semesters × $22,600 (2026–27 estimates)
illinois-msf.feesNote: Campus fees international $2,881 × 3 semesters = $8,643 (2026–27 estimates on Gies MSF tuition page). Non-refundable deposit $1,750 credited to tuition after 10th day of first semester.
illinois-msf.period: 2026–27 estimates (table shows Fall '26 / Spring '27 / Fall '27 sequence for Fall 2026 cohort). Fall 2027 entrants: analogous 3-semester sequence; later-term rates may change — tuition guarantee locks entering-cohort rate once enrolled.
illinois-msf.notes: MSF assessed per semester (not per credit), up to 20 credits/semester. US resident 3-semester total tuition+fees $57,846 (tuition $49,437 + fees $8,409). International total tuition+fees $76,443. Open external admits (not a UF/TAMU-style combination).

livingCostBand.basis: Registrar 2026–27 Grad additional expenses (intl): Food & Housing $16,512 + Books & Supplies $1,800 + Other $3,090 = $21,402 per academic year. Gies MSF domestic COA PDF lists Additional Expenses $9,935/semester (Food & Housing $7,490 + Books $900 + Other $1,545) → ×3 semesters = $29,705 (lifestyle-dependent).

tamu-msf.feesNote: No flat MSF program sticker published for external admits. ISSS 2025 one Fall-or-Spring estimate lists MS Finance student total $38,188 including tuition/fees/insurance and living for one major term only — not a full-degree sticker; not used as Fall 2027 program total (missing ≠ invent multi-term sum).
tamu-msf.notes: CRITICAL ACCESS FLAG: Mays MS Finance is a 4+1 / combination pathway. Official page and catalog: All applicants must currently be enrolled as undergraduates at Texas A&M University (sophomore-start and senior-start tracks). Not an open external Fall 2027 MSF for HK/TW/PRC applicants. 36 credit hours, College Station in-person. External applicants seeking finance master's are pointed by Mays marketing to other programs (e.g., Master of Financial Management) — out of this MSF id scope.
tamu-msf.startTerm: Aggie 4+1 timeline only (not open external Fall MSF)
tamu-msf.accessNote: Current Texas A&M undergraduates only (sophomores/seniors) per Mays 4+1 MS Finance and TAMU catalog.

ohio-msf.tuitionLabel: Fisher SMF non-resident and international estimated tuition and fees — 36 credit hours / 3 semesters (2026–27)
ohio-msf.feesNote: Published $68,093 already includes General Fee, Tuition & Instruction Fee, Student Activity Fee, Student Union Fee, Recreation Fee, Learning-Technology Fee, COTA Bus Fee. Student Health Insurance $4,108 (9 months) separate; international students cannot waive.
ohio-msf.period: 2026–27 academic year estimates (subject to change for future terms)
ohio-msf.notes: Specialized Master in Finance (SMF); STEM; 16 months / 3 semesters; Autumn entry only (Autumn 2027 classes begin Aug 24, 2027). Ohio resident tuition and fees $47,093. Forever Buckeye / residency pathways may change classification for some students — not assumed for intl.

livingCostBand.basis: Fisher SMF page Estimated Other Expenses (9 months): Housing, food & misc. $19,986 + Books and Supplies $1,516 = $21,502 (excludes Student Health Insurance $4,108). Program spans 16 months — summer/living beyond 9 months not itemized on page.

msu-msf.tuitionLabel: Broad MSF out-of-state / international block tuition and departmental fees total (2026–27 AY)
msu-msf.feesNote: Published $51,000 (OOS) / $46,500 (in-state) covers tuition charges for credits and departmental fees. Billed in three equal installments at start of each semester.
msu-msf.period: 2026–27 academic year (as stated on Broad MSF program page)
msu-msf.notes: STEM; 30 credits; 12 months full-time on-campus only. Tuition page (broad.msu.edu/masters/finance/tuition/) was Incapsula-blocked to WebFetch/curl during research; dollar figures taken from live program overview page which publishes the same 2026–27 block amounts. 40% non-sponsored financial-support claim sourced from Wayback snapshot of the tuition page (archive 2026-05-18 still showed prior-year stickers $49,500/$45,000 but same 40% language). Open external admits.
sources: Broad MS in Finance (tuition figures on overview)
Broad MSF Tuition & Financial Aid (Incapsula-blocked; Wayback used for support %)

auburn-msf.tuitionEstimateLabel: Estimate only: non-resident graduate tuition for 30-credit non-thesis MSF assuming two semesters at ≥9 credits each — 2 × ($1,975 × 9) = $35,550. NOT a published flat program sticker.
auburn-msf.feesNote: Estimate components (2026–27): College of Business Graduate professional fee $241/credit × 30 = $7,230; Student Services Fee $1,002 × 2 semesters = $2,004; Confirmation Fee $450 one-time; Graduation Fee $40 one-time → ≈ $9,724. Actual semester count / credit load changes fees. Alabama resident credit tuition $643/cr (capped at 9 hrs).
auburn-msf.period: 2026–27 per-credit / fee schedule (no flat MSF sticker)
auburn-msf.notes: Open Fall-only on-campus admits (also online modality). Bulletin non-thesis = 30 hours (admissions page text said 31 — use bulletin/curriculum 30). No published flat program tuition. Resident estimate 2 × ($643 × 9) = $11,574 tuition + same professional/services structure. Financial assistance page points to loans via Office of Financial Aid — no verified open applicant-facing merit SCH amounts.

ucsd-msf.tuitionLabel: Rady Master of Quantitative Finance (MQF; formerly Master of Finance) Fall 2025 cohort tuition — 52 units × $1,613/unit. PROXY for Fall 2027 — Fall 2026/2027 cohort rates not published as of asOf.
